India Ends Fuel Purchase Limits; Sri Lanka Reduces Prices

India has lifted temporary restrictions on the purchase of petrol and diesel. Concurrently, Sri Lanka has reduced its fuel retail prices following the easing of supply restrictions and a Middle East ceasefire. These developments indicate a stabilization in fuel availability and pricing in both nations.
